title: 2D Platformer Demo (Official)
notes: Official Godot sample: basic 2D platformer with CharacterBody2D movement, collisions, camera and collectibles.

title: 3D Platformer Demo (Official)
notes: Official 3D platformer demo with third‑person character controller, moving platforms and pickups.

title: Physics Platformer Demo (Official)
notes: Official 2D physics platformer using RigidBody2D to showcase forces, collisions and physics-based movement.

title: TPS Demo (Third Person Shooter)
notes: High‑quality third‑person shooter demo with aiming, enemies, advanced lighting and effects.

title: Godot Game Template
notes: General game skeleton with menus, save system, options, localization and scene management.

title: 2D Platformer - Starter Kit (G2P Studios)
notes: Juicy 2D platformer starter with animated player, two demo levels, score, SFX and documented code.

title: Godot 2D Platformer Starter Kit (Brett Chalupa)
notes: Complete 2D platformer (3 levels, music, SFX, main menu). Template code is public domain.

title: Open 2D Platformer (GDQuest)
notes: Advanced open‑source platformer with modular character, enemies and level design patterns (GDQuest course demo).

title: Godot 2D Top-Down Template (Stefh)
notes: Big top‑down framework with state machines, inventory, dialog, save/load, health bars and more.

title: Top-down Action RPG Template (NoidEXE)
notes: Zelda‑like action RPG starter with enemies, combat and basic progression systems.

title: Godot 4 Roguelike Tutorial (Bozar)
notes: Turn‑based roguelike with FOV, random dungeons, simple combat and a full written/tutorial series.

title: Top-down Shooter Core (Quiver)
notes: Modular shooter core: weapons, enemies, rooms and supporting systems for top‑down action games.

title: Tiny Wizard (Quiver demo)
notes: Binding‑of‑Isaac‑style open source room‑based shooter built on Quiver's Top‑Down Shooter Core.

title: Outpost Assault – Tower Defense (Quiver)
notes: Open source 2D tile‑based tower defense template for Godot 4 (Outpost Assault) built by Quiver.

title: Godot Tactical RPG Demo
notes: Grid‑based tactical RPG sample with movement ranges, pathfinding and tile‑based attacks.

title: Survivors Starter Kit (DarkRewar)
notes: Vampire Survivors‑style kit in C#: player stats, spells, hordes, bosses, upgrades and minimal UI.

title: Starter Kit 3D Platformer (Kenney)
notes: Stylized 3D platformer starter with character controller, coins, falling platforms and gamepad support.

title: Starter Kit FPS (Kenney)
notes: First‑person shooter kit with guns, enemies, pickups and CC0 models, textures and sounds.

title: Starter Kit City Builder (Kenney)
notes: 3D city‑builder template using GridMap: building placement, camera controls, save/load and CC0 city assets.

title: First Person Starter (Whimfoome)
notes: Well‑tuned first‑person controller with smooth movement, slopes, sprinting and air control.

title: COGITO: Immersive Sim Template
notes: Immersive‑sim style first‑person kit focused on interactable objects, inventory and systemic gameplay.

title: Dialogic Visual Novel Template
notes: Visual novel starter built around Dialogic: dialogue UI, choices, basic menus and flow control.

title: Rakugo Visual Novel Kit
notes: Ren’Py‑like VN kit with scripting API, menus, history, save/load and example project.

title: Godot 4.2 Card Game Starter Template
notes: Turn‑based card battler starter (Slay‑the‑Spire‑style) built for Godot 4.2.

title: Card Framework (Godot 4)
notes: Flexible card-game toolkit for Solitaire, TCGs and deckbuilding roguelikes with drag‑and‑drop card handling.
